Install the Nibleaf command-line tool to publish from your terminal. Pick your computer's system below.

## macOS

### Install

Open Terminal and run:

```sh
brew install nibleaf
```

### Sign in

Run `nibleaf login` and follow the link it shows.

## Windows

### Install

Open PowerShell as an administrator and run:

```powershell
winget install Nibleaf.CLI
```

Restart PowerShell so it finds the new command.

### Sign in

Run `nibleaf login` and follow the link it shows.

## Linux

### Install

Download the package for your distribution from the releases page, then run:

```sh
sudo dpkg -i nibleaf.deb
```

### Sign in

Run `nibleaf login` and follow the link it shows.
